title: 14 CFR § 107.150 Variable mode and variable configuration of small unmanned aircraft systems. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 107.150 Variable mode and variable configuration of small unmanned aircraft systems. (2025 edition)
sections.text: A small unmanned aircraft system may be eligible for one or more categories of operation over human beings under this subpart, as long as a remote pilot in command cannot inadvertently switch between modes or configurations.
